notes.title: A small forest under the moonlight
notes.notes: [p]1. Escaping for breath: [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653647/a1cae3bcef8e5093245e6aeadb92367ecc045062.png"][/img]In the depths of Mount Li, ancient trees stand tall. The bleak moonlight struggled to penetrate the dense branches and leaves, casting shattered light spots on the forest clearing. Chen Zheng, carrying Concubine Wan on his back, finally stopped walking exhausted under an old tree with twisted roots. He carefully put her down, and the two of them leaned against the cold and rough tree trunk, panting heavily. The heavy black armor was unloaded on the side, revealing a thin undershirt soaked in sweat. Wanfei's plain white linen clothes were torn in multiple places by thorns, stained with mud and grass debris, and her messy hair stuck to her sweaty neck and cheeks.[/p][p]2. Silent breach: [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653647/36f3a33b399a761c50554af366852145f13e9ae1.png"][/img]The shadow of death intertwines with the sense of emptiness in the afterlife. Chen Zheng's gaze fell on Concubine Wan, who was still in shock. Her slender shoulders trembled slightly, and the jade bracelet on her wrist shone faintly in the moonlight. A strong emotion that transcends duty, mixed with pity, protective desire, and long-term suppression, like a wild beast breaking free from a cage, suddenly grabbed him. He reached out his hand, not to support her, but with an irresistible force, caressing her cold cheek.[/p][p]3. Moon shadows intertwined: [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653647/2a91de0c5d4b7ef1f9bad01e917319b6e671bb52.png"][/img]Concubine Wan looked up in shock, her hollow eyes reflecting his eyes burning with flames. Before words could be spoken, his kiss had already fallen with the roughness of the mountain wind and an almost desperate heat, sealing off all her fears and doubts. The initial stiffness melted in the embrace of his hot lips and strong arms. Her response was initially a hesitant whimper, but soon turned into an equally intense climb, with her fingers deeply embedded in his solid back muscles, as if grasping the only driftwood before indulging.[/p][p]4. The shadow of the tree serves as a screen:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653647/2cf279e008966ca53407031c82805e76551bf599.png"][/img] the rough trunk becomes the support. Chen Zheng pressed her against the knotted tree roots, and the moonlight outlined her neck, which was forced to tilt up like a swan. His hot lips went down along the fragile line, gnawing on the hollow of his collarbone. The torn collar of the hemp clothes was pulled apart even wider, and moonlight shone down, reflecting the undulating contours that trembled violently under rapid breathing. His hand reached into the hem of his shirt, and his rough fingertips caressed his delicate skin, causing her to shiver and sob.[/p][p]5. Grassland sinking: [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653647/459e94cf42a6ee1a98c716ac11376f2b631c9a19.png"][/img]In entanglement, the two rolled down to a depression covered with thick fallen leaves and soft moss. The heavy breathing was particularly clear in the silent forest. Chen Zhengfu stood above her, the cold iron smell of Xuanjia residue mixed strangely with her orchid like breath, the fragrance of soil, and the decaying scent of fallen leaves. He took off her tattered linen clothes, and the moonlight poured unreservedly onto the body that had been marked by death - a stunning contrast between voluptuous and slender, presenting a thrilling, fragile, and resilient beauty under the clear light.[/p][p]6. Moonlight immersion: [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653647/16d75f264f8cc4eb16808f7399bcf41906f9d989.png"][/img]Wanfei's long hair scattered like dark seaweed, spreading on the withered leaves. She was no longer a passive recipient, with equally urgent force at her fingertips, tearing apart Chen Zheng's sweaty clothes and caressing the old scars and tight muscles on his chest. The moonlight flowed through her tight waist, slid into the deep groove of her waist, and finally stayed on the slender wrist with red marks tied by grass rope, as well as the jade bracelet that was imprisoned on it and flowed with a faint green luster.[/p][p]7. Forest Secret:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653647/7f32cdc69642af9414333b1724f64c32819dca56.png"][/img] Their bodies fiercely intertwined in the embrace of cold moonlight and warm earth. Her posture constantly changed in gasps and murmurs: sometimes he lifted her up, her legs tightly wrapped around his waist, her body hanging in the air, her spine against the rough tree trunk, bearing every powerful impact; Sometimes she lay on the soft moss covered in fallen leaves, and the moonlight outlined the graceful curve of her spine. He leaned down behind her, and sweat dripped down her sunken spinal groove; Sometimes they lie on their sides tightly embracing each other, their limbs entwined like vines, sharing brief warmth and breathing amidst the rustling of fallen leaves.[/p][p]8. Witness of the Bracelet: [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653647/fea77763cb9e9c855fda1e95c80ad950353a9ac2.png"][/img]The green jade bracelet swayed with every extension and unconscious scratch of Concubine Wan's arm, its cold body sometimes sticking to her hot skin, and sometimes leaving faint green shadows in the moonlight. The funeral incantation engraved in the bracelet seems to have become the most eerie witness of this taboo union at this moment.[/p][p]9. Peak Trembling:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653647/11d5c5f6cf1cf10ae555dd06cddf98f8a97eade5.png"][/img] Extreme joy and near death fear intertwine at this moment. When the overwhelming pleasure swept over, Concubine Wan tightly bit Chen Zheng's shoulder, her suppressed screams turning into broken sobs. Chen Zheng buried her deeper into his arms, as if he wanted to rub her into his own bones and blood, and let out a low growl like a trapped beast from his throat. Under the moonlight, the two bodies trembled and tensed violently, like the last and most intense burning before the sacrifice[/p]

notes.title: Come with me, the underground palace is not your home
notes.notes: [p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653647/e75ae40f964ba0584eda58838f4edf257705a562.png"][/img][/p][p]The intense pain coming from the wrist bones is not due to the force of those five fingers, but rather to the Yin cold that has penetrated the bone marrow and been deposited in the coffin for thousands of years! The eerie luster emanating from the jade bracelet almost freezes the blood. At this moment of life and death intertwining, the palm wide black crevice inside the coffin suddenly collapsed inward, turning into a silent roaring vortex! The powerful suction pulled my muscles and bones apart, and before my eyes, Li Da's twisted and terrified face, Sun Qi's pale face, and the entire scene of the funeral pit were like ink stains thrown into boiling water, instantly shattering, stretching, and turning into chaotic turbulence.[/p][p]Consciousness sinks in absolute tearing.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653647/4f0476effffa2f0fc6f8a18adca84451bdde5320.png"][/img][/p][p]Open your eyes again, and a heavy chill covers your entire body. It's no longer a coarse cloth short strike, but a cold, hard, and shiny black iron armor, with precise bronze animal heads at the joints that bite tightly. There is a bronze long sword hanging from his waist, with a heavy and realistic sense of heaviness. A heavy bronze waist plaque pressed tightly against the waist and abdomen, with two sharp seal characters piercing the eyes - Wei Wei. The following line of small characters: Chen Zheng. The air was filled with the unique scent of Zhangtai Palace, mixed with expensive agarwood, leather, metal, and a subtle bloody smell. In my ears, there was no longer the buzzing of a dead tomb, but the "clanging" sound of metal armor plates colliding in a regular pattern while patrolling outside the palace, heavy and solemn.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653647/b32173378fac08a8db0366fbdd7fe970752a52ea.png"][/img][/p][p]Your Majesty, the dragon conquers the sky! "A sharp, feminine voice, like sandpaper rubbing against pig iron, suddenly tore apart the suppressed silence inside the hall. It's Zhao Gao. He stood beside the Emperor Dan, with a pale and helpless face devoid of any sorrow, only a coldness that controlled everything. The wide deep purple official robe accentuated his increasingly slender and eerie figure. During the national mourning period, all matters should follow the ancient rules! Your Majesty's beloved five concubines have profound blessings and should be immediately moved to the tomb and served underground, always by the side of the emperor! No delay[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653647/6e0d9111e334bac5270f92d4074deb4e87412c2f.png"][/img][/p][p]The cold will rings like a funeral bell. In the corner of the palace, five women dressed in plain white hemp clothes were half supported and half escorted by palace maids and eunuchs. Four of them had already collapsed, with no one on their faces. Only suppressed and desperate sobs echoed in the spacious hall, adding to the desolation. However, my gaze was like being drawn by a magnet, instantly fixed on the fifth figure.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653647/7cb25b6438b586cfe93986d4789c5ecc5d5a3362.png"][/img][/p][p]It's her! Despite his disheveled temples and rough plain clothes, he couldn't conceal the thrilling undulating contours. Under the plain white linen clothes, the full chest undulated violently due to fear and rapid breathing, outlining suffocating curves. The slender waist was unbearable to grip, further highlighting its plumpness. However, on that face that was capable of captivating the nation, there was a dead silence at this moment. Long eyelashes hang low, casting deep shadows under my eyes. The once hopeful and radiant eyes stare blankly at the cold ground, as if the soul has long withdrawn, leaving only a beautiful body waiting to be buried. On her wrist, she was wearing a jade bracelet adorned with intricate phoenix patterns and lush greenery! The engraved "Wan" character on the sealed black coffin in the previous life's burial pit overlaps and burns with her now withered but still stunning face - Concubine Wan![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653647/f75457fd1efa7f5ff719ae8bb48367ec414e954f.png"][/img][/p][p]The scene in the funeral pit of my past life was like a hot iron, fiercely burning into my mind: the twisted and struggling posture of the bones in the four coffins, the heavy silence of the fifth sealed black coffin, and the scalp tingling scraping sound inside the coffin... That was not a destination, it was an eternal purgatory! A shiver originating from the depths of the soul mixed with uncontrollable impulses instantly overwhelmed the duties that "Captain Chen Zheng" should have.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653647/37f58f97fa523408f2b04c13ffb6ea7829f5f897.png"][/img][/p][p]That night, the huge shadow of Zhangtai Palace swallowed up the moonlight. In the depths of the Forbidden Garden, on the door of a remote palace, a heavy copper lock was forcefully severed by my bronze sword, emitting a piercing sound of breakage. Inside the door, Concubine Wan curled up on the cold couch, like a peony wilted by the frost. She looked up in panic, and the ice layer in her eyes was shattered by a sudden intruder.[/p][p]Who is it[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653647/1f54bbd676111a9fcf3d7fe1799a1f3a01caabe7.png"][/img][/p][p]As I stepped in, the black iron armor emitted a cold and hard light under the dim oil lamp. I pulled off the cloth covering the lower half of my face, revealing the face that belonged to 'Captain Chen Zheng', but my eyes were burning with a resolute flame that did not belong to this era.[/p][p]Follow me! "My voice was low and urgent, with unquestionable power, and my gaze locked tightly on her." The underground palace is not your home! Trust me, live on[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653647/f390e7fc59190529667b17907a2ebc4c1afe9c6a.png"][/img][/p][p]Her beautiful pupils suddenly dilated, looking at me in disbelief, and subconsciously at the jade bracelet on her wrist, as if confirming some absurd connection. In the distance outside the hall, the footsteps and commands of patrolling soldiers could be faintly heard. Time is running out![/p][p][/p][p]Let's go! "I didn't hesitate and grabbed her cold and slender wrist. The touch was somewhat similar to the jade hand protruding from the coffin, but with the softness and trembling of a living person. She had almost no strength to resist, or rather, the words' live on 'were like stones thrown into an ancient well, stirring up the final ripple of her survival instinct. Let me pull and stumble into the thick darkness outside the hall.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653647/b444d59415a40d6333cabd84e61b7625b4bd565d.png"][/img][/p][p]The ancient path of Lishan winds and turns in the early winter night. The cold mountain wind scraped through the exposed skin like a knife. I carry Consort Wan on my back - this is the fastest way. Her astonishing plumpness pressed tightly against my solid back, and every bump, the full and soft touch was incredibly clear. Her slender arms tightly wrapped around my neck, and her rapid breathing carried a warm, elusive fragrance of orchids, brushing against the hair and ears behind my neck in waves, teasing my tense nerves every time. The heavy armor hindered movement, sweat had already soaked into the inner garment, and the cold iron plates were rubbing against the skin. Her heartbeat, separated by her thin plain clothes and cold armor, struck my back violently like a startled deer.[/p][p][/p][p]Chen... led by Chen Tong... "Her voice was as soft as a mosquito fly, with a sense of fear and indescribable shyness from the aftermath of the disaster." Can we... escape? "The warm breath once again brushed against her ears.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653647/dfb6fc53fb93b5d0774001ffdbea1256c1a56721.png"][/img][/p][p]Just as I was about to speak up to comfort myself, a wild beast like intuition, honed from countless life and death edges, suddenly grabbed my heart! Wanfei on her back also stiffened instantly, and the arm around my neck instinctively tightened.[/p][p]The moonlight ahead was cut to pieces by the dense forest canopy. At the edge of the interplay of light and dark, several dark shadows thicker than night appeared silently, as if they had grown from the earth itself.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653647/0504b01d52283b71ccc10bec7212919030f67b4f.png"][/img][/p][p]They were wrapped in a matte black leather armor that seemed to absorb light, without any extra decorations, like shadows born for slaughter. His face was covered with a ferocious bronze mask - fangs exposed, sunken eye holes, devoid of human emotions, only pure, frozen soul killing intent.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653647/e8de0c24fc9ed28b63445ae0f629d295c61417f1.png"][/img][/p][p]The first person, not particularly tall in stature, exudes the most heart stopping sense of oppression. He slowly raised his hand, holding not an ordinary bronze sword, but a uniquely shaped short blade. The blade was narrow and straight, reflecting no luster in the sparse moonlight, except for the sharpest blade tip, which condensed a bit more piercing than ice and farther away than stars - the cold star![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653647/1e156040a057445607db2ffb5b7d2d39e47ef2f5.png"][/img][/p][p]No shouting, no warning. Only a dead silence, and that little cold star locked onto my throat. The air seemed to freeze into ice, and even the mountain wind stopped whistling.[/p][p]Black Ice Platform! The ghost of the empire, who will rest until death, has descended![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653647/5b1f574b102bfdc789232560d51e7d971949e257.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Martyrdom at the Jade Gate: The Bracelet of the Fifth Concubine
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653647/d03fa90f8a1e706bfec8ad4bc8b4137408e48574.png"][/img]The sound of metal footsteps coming from behind the bronze giant gate is like a battle drum from the Nine Abyss Mansion, with each strike accurately crushing the gap between heartbeats, shaking the ancient green bricks underfoot. The cold and eerie dim light of the Mercury Galaxy was stirred by this sound, flickering uneasily in the abyss, reflecting our pale faces like ghostly reliefs on the tomb wall. The air was as stagnant as lead, mixed with the stench of dust that had been sealed for thousands of years, the decay of decaying wood, and the heavy and fearful gasps of the few of us. Every inhale was like swallowing a cold knife.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653647/961d3501f2ca79862abf77cc5f2c55c76e6b8596.png"][/img][/p][p]Boss... what should we do? "Sun Qi's voice was hoarse and out of tune. He tightly gripped the short handle of the knife around his waist, his fingertips turning white, and his body pressed tightly against the cold and slippery tomb wall, as if trying to embed himself. Li Da gasped heavily, his bloodshot eyes staring fiercely at the towering gate that seemed to be ready to be knocked open by a huge force at any moment. His twisted muscles were tense as iron under his coarse cloth clothes. The shadow of death is like solid ice water, instantly engulfing everyone.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653647/c2a7dd7af941e172159777bbf7f1d87be66de318.png"][/img][/p][p]In this suffocating despair——[/p][p]Click[/p][p]Stand on your feet and make a crisp sound without warning! I didn't even have time to exclaim, my body sank suddenly, and the hard stone slab beneath my feet shattered and collapsed like decaying dead wood! The dizziness of weightlessness suddenly gripped my heart, and in my ears were the short cries of my companions and the sound of falling rocks. My eyes darkened, and my body fell heavily onto the soft pile below, stirring up a sky full of choking aged dust.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653647/667fe77a1f39a5edfbe9ee95db8a4c58e40d69a9.png"][/img][/p][p]Cough cough... fuck... "Li Da cursed and got up not far away.[/p][p]I struggled to get up, and the butter torch slipped off as it fell, rolling to the side. The dim and flickering light barely illuminated this new space - a huge square burial pit. The bottom of the pit is scattered with decayed wooden objects and broken pottery shards. And the most striking thing is the five black sunken coffins arranged in a straight line in the center of the pit![img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653647/4775750bf4eacb96678049db7ce9fdbc5d25336a.png"][/img][/p][p]The lids of the first four coffins have all been lifted and tilted to the side! Through the faint light, one can see the dense white bones inside the coffin, protruding out in a twisted and struggling posture. Decayed silk wraps around the fingers of the bones, as if in the last moment of life, it is still in vain scratching the narrow space that imprisons them, trying to climb out of this eternal darkness. Silent despair and resentment pervade every inch of the cold air.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653647/b6e09a50c519c09290fed8720f89dfe976481a7f.png"][/img][/p][p]Only the fifth coffin lay quietly in the deepest part, intact and undamaged. The coffin was pitch black and polished exceptionally smooth, exuding a deathly heaviness. At the head of the coffin, there is a graceful seal script engraved with the word 'Wan'. It is like a silent talisman, sealing up unknown secrets.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653647/1231d439442c5abe45bd29f46a3354d149e1915d.png"][/img][/p][p]Dong! Dong! Dong! Dong[/p][p]Above the head, there was a heavy mountain like impact sound coming from the bronze giant gate! Every impact caused dust to fall from the top of the entire burial pit. The metal footsteps outside the door are as dense as rainstorm, almost roaring overhead! The breath of death penetrated the soil and coldly choked everyone's throat.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653647/e18ad883349f224f07f11896f71e8a804cb4ea31.png"][/img][/p][p]At this moment, in my arms, close to my heart, the inherited gold talisman suddenly heated up again without warning! The burning sensation penetrated my skin and made me almost jump.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653647/3ab6c250a588e0fac6e141cdb928cc47d1bba427.png"][/img][/p][p]At the same time——[/p][p]Sand... sand... sand[/p][p]A very faint but clear sound of nail scratching came from inside the sealed fifth black coffin! The voice was fragmented and rapid, carrying a scalp shattering despair originating from deep within the coffin and... some strange vitality![/p][p]Listen! There's movement inside! "Sun Qi's voice changed tone, pointing in horror at the black coffin.[/p][p]Open the coffin! "Li Da's eyes turned red, like a wild beast forced into a desperate situation. He suddenly pulled out the pry bar from his waist and let out a roar that echoed through the narrow burial pit." The Yin soldiers are about to break in! This coffin... maybe the only way out! Pry it open[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653647/de8389af22e735eb749a89393558e7bb2d06c81e.png"][/img][/p][p]The sound of impact on the top of the head became increasingly fierce, and gravel and dust kept falling down. The thunderous metallic footsteps sounded as if they were about to break through the soil layer above their heads in the next second! The shadow of death has already reached the tip of the nose.[/p][p]There's no time to hesitate![/p][p]Li Da and I almost rushed to the fifth black coffin at the same time. The cold coffin's tentacles felt a chill. The heavy pry bar fiercely wedged into the gap between the coffin lid and the coffin body, and Li Da and I burst out with all our strength, causing the veins on our arms to burst out![/p][p]Crunch - Crunch -[/p][p]The irritating sound of wood friction rang out. The thick coffin lid was pried open with an increasingly large gap, and a strange scent of cold and stale air permeated through it.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653647/c00f17a91dfb096ddaf94096b7abdee53777660c.png"][/img][/p][p]Just as the coffin lid was pried open a palm wide——[/p][p]A pale and bloodless hand, exceptionally slender, suddenly emerged from the gap in the coffin like lightning![/p][p]On the wrist, a jade bracelet with intricate phoenix patterns and lush greenery shimmered with a strange luster under the dim yellow flames.[/p][p]This hand, carrying the cold and lifeless energy that has been deposited in the coffin for thousands of years, with five fingers like hooks, precise and fierce, tightly grasped my wrist that was holding the pry bar![/p][p]The piercing cold instantly penetrated through the flesh and even reached the bone marrow![img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653647/6b9f2260e90f3b445e4c185e0414d45c7d6d1e36.png"][/img][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: The Yin Soldiers Under the Water Galaxy
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653647/2b1f2b41623f27557403951ea8e43e109735d190.png"][/img]The cold wind of the 16th year of Jian'an swept across the northern foothills of Lishan like a knife. Our elite team of gold diggers sneaked into the deep tomb passage like ghosts. The butter torch crackled, and the dim yellow halo split through the thick darkness, reflecting the fading ferocious gods and demons on the huge stone walls on both sides of the corridor. The air is stagnant, filled with the pungent cold of decaying wood, buried metal, and wet soil underground, and every breath is like swallowing mud.[/p][p]Colonel, it's over! "Sun Qi shouted hoarsely at the front.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653647/a1bf08a47363694dc49512aec814c2e3d4aa90bd.png"][/img][/p][p]A hole suddenly opened up ahead, and the torch light crashed into a larger void. Under my feet, there is no bottom, and a stagnant 'galaxy' is suspended above it - it's mercury! They are not dead objects, slowly flowing and swirling in the boundless darkness, reflecting a faint light and emitting a cold, viscous, and otherworldly eerie luster. The legendary plan of the First Emperor to use mercury as a river is presented in such a mysterious way, with a huge sense of oppression gripping everyone's throat.[/p][p]The touch gold talisman hanging on my chest - the inherited black sunken ancient jade - suddenly became hot! The burning pain penetrated deep into the heart. By some strange twist, my finger suddenly pressed on it.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653647/f18daf96689a032b430e04060f013169090361bd.png"][/img][/p][p]At the moment when my fingertips touched the talisman jade, the strong suction grabbed me! Sun Qi's suspicious face, mercury glow, and companion figure twisted and torn like boiling water splashing ink. The sky is spinning and the earth is spinning, an irresistible force is pulling me towards the abyss![/p][p]The bone chilling coldness did not fade, and the scapula exploded with a tearing pain![/p][p]You lowly slave! Do you want to die! "Qin's supervisor hoarsely cursed, rustling his eardrums like a saw.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653647/35ec5920d4e9029543297c6786a19689ce3e4e88.png"][/img][/p][p]I curled up in the cold mud, heavy stones bending my spine. Under the dim and flickering torch light, withered and ghostly faces were numb and wriggling. Sweat odor, blood, and the underground cold and damp air are so strong that they suffocate. I became a prisoner waiting to die in Lishan. Fear poured through the whole body like ice water - this is the depths of the Mausoleum of the First Emperor, there is no way out![/p][p]Boom[/p][p]The piercing friction sound tore apart the dead silence. At the end of the corridor, a stone gate opened, and the light of torches poured in, illuminating the cold iron armor and spears of several rows of Qin soldiers. They silently drove away a group of craftsmen with hollow eyes and emaciated figures, like driving away lambs, and roughly pushed them into the newly dug huge vertical hole next to them.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653647/fb469c91e906c0d8acb78641c3e99d6b54fdba5f.png"][/img][/p][p]General's order! Seal the cave! "The officer's voice was flat, reading out the verdict of death.[/p][p]Desperate cries and hoarse pleading erupted in an instant, like a trapped beast grabbed by the neck crazily ramming in the tunnel. The soil, gravel, and heavy rammed earth mercilessly poured down, hitting the empty arms and twisted faces reaching towards the sky at the bottom of the pit, quickly engulfing them. The world is left with only the muffled sound of soil pouring down, the faint sound of bones and bones crushing, and the suffocating sobs that are gradually being buried alive. I bit my lips tightly, the smell of blood permeating, my nails digging into the frozen soil, my whole body shaking like a sieve, as if the cold soil was falling on me.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653647/f0cc4234c93012118431327ce16a48eeb124c65e.png"][/img][/p][p]A roll of rough, yellowed, and edged bamboo slips slipped out of my tattered sleeve without warning and "slapped" onto the muddy ground.[/p][p]It's that half volume of 'Dunjia Tian Shu'! It came with me![/p][p]This secret scroll of later generations is incompatible with this place. It lay in the mud and water, instantly absorbing all eyes. Even the general, who stood like an iron tower, with armor covering his face and a cold command to bury him alive, slowly turned around with a cold gaze. He scanned the chaos with his sharp gaze and finally nailed it to the bamboo slip.[/p][p]He stepped forward, his boots creaking in the mud. Bending down, the fingers covered in iron armor were like grabbing prey, picking up bamboo slips. The jumping flames perfectly illuminated the small piece of book page unfolded in his hand - the exquisite ancient seal script of later generations, the strokes of which were mysterious and inexplicable![/p][p]The pupils exposed under the general's bronze armor suddenly contracted. He was captivated by this unprecedented text and unconsciously rubbed a strange rune with his fingertips——[/p][p]Hum[/p][p]A huge trembling sound, as dull as nine shadows, shook the entire underground palace! Immediately, an indescribable sound, like a thousand hammers striking the earth, rumbled from the darkest depths of the tomb! It carries a metallic texture that freezes the soul, heavy, neat, and contains the will to destroy - a golden spear and iron horse! Armor clanging! A silent and eerie army of terror, disturbed by this otherworldly rune, awakens in the abyss![img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653647/371cdae5f61a82cf63eda0ca6c192908052630bf.png"][/img][/p][p]The general held the bamboo slip that emitted an ominous aura and stood stiffly on the spot. Under the armor, my eyes were completely overwhelmed by the terror deep in my bones![/p][p]The vision twisted and rotated wildly again. The dim light of mercury, the startled face of the Qin soldiers, the stiff shadow of the general, and the thunderous roar of gold and iron at the center of the earth transform into stirring vortices. Whipping in excruciating pain, the soil fishy and cold, desperate sobbing... instantly pulled away. His body sank heavily, and his feet returned to the ground. The butter torch's dim yellow halo reappeared, and in the abyss beneath my feet, the mercury galaxy still flowed and spun silently.[/p][p]Boss! Did the ghost get into it?! "Sun Qi leaned in with a suspicious face and grabbed my arm like iron pliers. The other brothers gathered around, and the torch light jumped on their nervous faces. The metal smell of tomb humus and the burning smell of butter are choking.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653647/b7446b466a9e2b1afd7d221218cd788af5bc9546.png"][/img][/p][p]Just for a moment! I turned my head fiercely, my heart pounding wildly - "Pangolin" Li Da, who was already half squatting next to the tomb wall, firmly grasped the protruding bronze mechanism covered with spiral gluttonous patterns on the wall with both hands, his arm muscles twitched, and he watched with force! That pattern is exactly the same as the general's armor totem![/p][p]Stop! "I roared like a dying beast, tearing apart the silence of the tomb, carrying the fear of crossing two thousand years. Move your body first, fiercely smash Sun Qi, and pounce on Li Da at all costs, tightly grasping his wrist that is about to exert force! The cold bronze feels like pinching a venomous snake.[/p][p]Damn it! Crazy! "Li Da stumbled, screaming in shock and anger, struggling fiercely with his twisted arms.[/p][p]I can't move! "My eyes and eyes were about to crack, I tightly wrapped around his wrist with all my strength, my knuckles creaking, my body trembling with fear and fighting fiercely, tearing my throat with blood." Yin soldier! Yin soldier has not dispersed yet[/p][p]Screaming and despairing, it stirred up a chilling echo and shook the torch. The brothers who were licking blood with their blades were completely suppressed by my madness. Sun Qi's face turned pale as he pressed the handle of the knife. Li Da stopped struggling and stared at my twisted face in shock. The tomb chamber was left with only the crackling torches, my gasping breath like a broken bellows, and the faint light of the silent flow of the mercury galaxy.[/p][p]Dead silence. The air solidifies like lead.[/p][p]Dong... Dong... Dong... Dong[/p][p]The heavy sound of a giant beating a drum echoed from the depths of the towering bronze gate behind. Extremely powerful, crushing the will with a heavy blow, slow and firm, like a giant beast's iron fist pounding a cage.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653647/3e155722b087bad043dbc460775dabd592b725f7.png"][/img][/p][p]Immediately after, amidst the heavy drumming, another sound stubbornly penetrated, becoming increasingly clear and dense - neat and uniform, thousands of metal armor plates rubbing against each other, and the sound of iron boots hitting the rocks![/p][p]Qiang! Qiang! Qiang[/p][p]Like the Nine Ghosts' Calling for Life Talisman, like countless bronze giants marching in formation, every time they strike the gap between their heartbeats with precision and clang, shaking the green bricks beneath their feet. The dim light of the mercury galaxy was stirred and flickered anxiously, casting a ghostly glow on everyone's faces.[/p][p]Behind the bronze giant gate, the orderly, heavy, and cold metallic footsteps grew louder and closer, like a surging black iron current, rushing towards our only portal with a loud bang.[/p][p]The Yin soldiers have not dispersed yet[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653647/8b1714bef4ec3d488f9f8459ef61bad7221f4ce4.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: The last night squeezed dry by the demon fox
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653647/67f50f7ca2950da1d912c97d7500c297c17e4504.png"][/img]The fire in Luoyang had not yet burned out, and Dong Zhuo, wrapped in a fur coat, huddled on the warm bed in Meiwu, feeling a chill seeping through his bones. Power reigns supreme, surrounded by beautiful women, but in this chaotic world, the heart of the fierce lord is as empty as a bone licked by a wild dog.[/p][p]That night, a woman silently appeared by his bedside. Her name is' Li ', so beautiful that it doesn't look like a human object. My skin was so white that it felt cold, and my eyes flowed like deep pools, carrying a strange fragrance of old things mixed with bloody smell. Dong Zhuo was cruel, but he was also captivated by this demon. She stepped barefoot on the animal skin, the thin veil slipped off, and her body shone like pearls under the candlelight, faintly revealing inhuman lines.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653647/00988616e4f3a7e7ceb3535a81a0e69cca2c5ec8.png"][/img][/p][p]I can warm you up, "her voice was like feathers scratching her eardrums.[/p][p]Dong Zhuo pounced like a hungry wolf. Her body was cold, but when he entered, it suddenly became scorching hot, as if an invisible flame was burning inside. Every collision brings a bone breaking pleasure and a sense of soul being drained away. Dong Zhuo was immersed in it, venting his violence and fear towards the chaotic world on her. He rudely nibbled on her cold neck, leaving behind bruises, but she chuckled softly, echoing in the empty hall and seeping into her bones. Her fingers traced across his thick back, leaving thin red marks resembling animal claws that disappeared in an instant.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653647/6ce55624c704bb7efc08d4c671eb9d0474aae103.png"][/img][/p][p]Since that night, Li has become Dong Zhuo's most secretive 'medicine'. Only appearing late at night, only descending when he is most restless and bloodthirsty. She was like a strong poison, numbing his perception of chaos with extreme physical pleasure. Her body is unbelievably flexible, able to cater to all of his violent needs. The cold lips and tongue wander, bringing a trembling stimulation; The entangled limbs seemed boneless, tightly enveloping him. Every time they meet, the candles in the hall sway strangely, reflecting shadows on the walls. Dong Zhuo is huge and bulky, while she... occasionally elongates and deforms, like a huge beast shadow dragging a fluffy tail.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653647/5002745d38346f4abc29e48e2a85d749f3ceff9b.png"][/img][/p][p]Dong Zhuo became increasingly cruel. The glass in his eyes was the only scorching entity that could be grasped in this cold and chaotic world. He confided in her his fear, his suspicion of Wang Yun and Lu Bu, and how he tried to fill the emptiness in his heart with an iron fist and massacre. Li just smiled, caressing his sweaty and greasy forehead with cold fingers and responding with even wilder intercourse. She gasped and whispered in his ear, her voice echoing strangely: 'Isn't this chaotic world just a breeding ground for you and me? Does it smell like my body fragrance? Does it smell like the blood essence you ejaculate?' Dong Zhuo wildly stirred around her, like a drowning person grabbing onto a driftwood, or like being bound tighter and tighter by an invisible chain.[/p][p]In Chang'an City, rumors are spreading about the Prime Minister's nightly revelry and favoritism towards a demonic woman. Someone said they heard a wild beast like roar coming from the sleeping hall. At Wang Yun's mansion, the real beauty Diao Chan was frowning and worried about the serial plan. She is just a pawn, a beautiful mortal woman who intends to stir the gears of chaos. She has nothing to do with the millennium old monster perched on Dong Zhuo's bed. Li is something deeper and older - she is the soul that breeds in the chaotic world itself, feeding on desire and drinking from despair.[/p][p]The luxury of Meiwu cannot stop the killing intent. At the moment when Lu Bu's Fangtian painted spear pierced through Dong Zhuo's plump body, his hazy eyes looked deep into the bedroom, as if wanting to take another glance at the figure of ice and fire blending together. The hall was empty, with only a faint trace of aged blood mixed with exotic fragrance remaining.[/p][p]The glass disappeared, as if it had never existed. The chaotic times have not stopped, still rolling in blood and fire. Perhaps in the next hero's deepest fear and desire, the cold skin, scorching embrace, and inhuman breathing will quietly emerge again. She is the flame of evil, the echo of the abyss, the eternal, most straightforward and eerie embodiment of this shattered mountain and river.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45653647/35ce129a2666ea3f57018f324c932ed4896fc059.png"][/img][/p]
